info.title: CLOSER API
info.description: Practice-only interview mentor. Findings cite evidence, state confidence, and may abstain. No endpoint returns an aggregate readiness score, and none ever will.

get.summary: Liveness probe
Role packs, each stating whether any agreement has been measured for it
Interview format presets derived from published company guidance
Rubric v1 with its per-level anchors
Personas as policy configuration — action weights and pressure ceiling
The typed policy actions code chooses between, and what each one probes

post.summary: Mint a throwaway owner token for the showcase instance
Extract the claim set from a résumé, sourced to byte-exact spans
Confirm, reject or reword a claim (§4.1: the candidate owns the claim set)
Start an interview over the confirmed claim set and return the first question
Submit one answer and receive the next question and any findings

get.summary: The session as replayed from its event log
The raw append-only event log, in seq order
Server-sent turn updates for an interview in progress
The gap ledger, across every session (§4.6)
Re-fold the log and re-check every citation byte-for-byte
What is due across every session, and the rounds that would cover it
Every judgment about one claim or competency, oldest first, with its quotes

post.summary: Record observable delivery for one spoken answer — never part of any judgment

get.summary: Delivery observations recorded for this session
Everything CLOSER holds about you, as events plus the view they fold into

delete.summary: Delete a pinned repository snapshot; its citations survive as a tombstone

get.summary: What is kept, for how long, and what deletion means for a past session
Recent durable jobs for this owner
One job, including the error that buried it

post.summary: Queue a repository ingestion; parsing runs isolated, never in this process
Queue an export bundle to be written to disk
Queue a retention sweep over expired repository snapshots

get.summary: The job kinds this build knows how to run
Every published benchmark run, failures included
One run in full: manifest, transcripts, per-item outcomes, gates
